text:
Maya (Product): Quick internal FYI — realtime-toolcall-bridge is GA on Hosted API as of now. This unifies streaming + callback orchestration into a single ergonomic endpoint. Rolling regionally, full rollout expected within 4h. :rocket:

Devon (Runtime): Nice! What changes do clients see?

Maya (Product): User-facing: new endpoint POST /v1/toolcall/bridge-stream and a routing hint header X-Redwood-Priority (latency | cost | balanced). Supports streaming, callbacks, and auto-fallback to streaming-only if callbacks fail. Backwards compatible with existing toolcall routes.

Priya (SRE): Rollout plan? Canary and what to watch?

Maya (Product): Canary in us-central1 for 20m, then staged ramp. Watch bridge.backpressure.metric, p99_first_byte, callback.failure_rate. Alert if bridge.backpressure > 5% for 5m.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-bridge v1.0.0 -> canary(us-central1) at 1845000300. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-bridge/1.0.0

Devon (Runtime): Runtime notes: bridge workers batch short-lived callbacks and maintain warm TCP pools to reduce TTFB. We added a soft backpressure signal to the router; it returns error code 4721 when overloaded. Clients should retry with exponential backoff or switch to streaming-only.

Maya (Product): Customer-facing guidance: prefer X-Redwood-Priority: latency for interactive UIs, cost for bulk operations. Bridge optimizes for lower end-to-end latency when priority=latency. There's a small callback surcharge — include cost table in docs.

Jared (Docs): Can I get sample payloads and a short migration note?

Devon (Runtime): Sample streaming+callback curl:
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall/bridge-stream \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Priority: latency" \\
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-3b","mode":"stream+callback","callback_url":"https://hooks.example/receive","callback_timeout_ms":4500}'
```

Priya (SRE): New runbook items: add 4721 mapping (bridge-backpressure) with suggested mitigations: retry after jitter, lower concurrency or switch to cost/balanced. Adding dashboards for bridge.backpressure.rate, bridge.retry_after, callback.latency_p95.

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-bridge v1.0.0 -> us-central1 OK (1845001200). Next: ramp to eu-west-1 at +15m.

Jared (Docs): I'll add migration notes, example SDK snippets, and a cost tradeoffs section. ETA 2 hours. Putting a short blurb in the changelog now: https://internal.redwood/changelog#bridge-ga

Maya (Product): Heads-up to Support: new error 4721 = bridge-backpressure, 4602 still exists for callback-timeout. Support snippets: if 4721, recommend retry + reduce concurrency or use streaming-only.

Priya (SRE): I'll set alerts: bridge.backpressure.rate > 3% for 10m -> page. Also create a procedural note for on-call to temporarily steer traffic to legacy toolcall if needed.

Devon (Runtime): Minor ops note: we bumped default connection pool size and adjusted KV cache retention for bridge sessions to minimize cold starts. No customer action needed.

Jared (Docs): Published doc patch and sample app PR: https://internal.redwood/docs/bridge and https://git.internal/redwood/sample-apps/pull/204

DeployBot: rollout complete across regions at 1845003160. All regions report healthy.

Maya (Product): Thanks team — please react with :thumbsup: when your tasks are complete. We'll monitor metrics and post any regressions to #incidents if they appear.

Devon (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Priya (SRE): :thumbsup:

Jared (Docs): :thumbsup:

Maya (Product): Closing: GA complete. If you see customer-impacting issues, ping me or @oncall immediately.
